llm.summary: This skill is a coherent writing-voice generator with narrow local profile reads, but users should understand that broad triggers may load saved voice data and that generated text may be normalized before review.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts match the stated purpose: generating text in a learned writing voice using saved extraction, register, craft-rule, and banned-phrase files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger terms include broad words like voice, generation, and writing, which could activate the skill more often than a user expects.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill instructions and modules only; no executable scripts, install hooks, or package-time commands were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads scoped local paths under $HOME/.claude/voice-profiles/{name} and an optional project .voice/override.md, which is purpose-aligned but should be expected by the user.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It mentions saving pre-review and post-review snapshots only when learning mode is active, with no evidence of automatic exfiltration, credential access, privilege escalation, or destructive behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want the agent to use local saved writing-voice profiles. Keep sensitive material out of those profile and override files, and review generated drafts because the skill may automatically remove or substitute banned phrases before presenting the final output.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger terms are real and broader than necessary, but they do not by themselves show deception or malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Reading saved voice-profile and project override files is central to the skill's stated purpose and is limited to disclosed paths, though the user should know this happens.
[SQP-2] expected: The silent post-generation banned-phrase and punctuation cleanup is disclosed in the artifacts and supports the writing-style goal, but users should review final text because lexical substitutions may change wording.
